def rotate_90(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    return [[grid[n-1-j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

def rotate_180(grid):
    return rotate_90(rotate_90(grid))

def rotate_270(grid):
    return rotate_90(rotate_90(rotate_90(grid)))

def reflect_horizontal(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid]

def reflect_vertical(grid):
    return grid[::-1]

def reflect_diagonal(grid):
    return [[grid[j][i] for j in range(len(grid))] for i in range(len(grid[0]))]

def reflect_anti_diagonal(grid):
    return [[grid[n-1-j][n-1-i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

# Test different transformations
print("90° clockwise:", rotate_90(input_grid))
print("180° rotation:", rotate_180(input_grid))
print("270° clockwise:", rotate_270(input_grid))
print()
print("Horizontal flip:", reflect_horizontal(input_grid))
print("Vertical flip:", reflect_vertical(input_grid))
print("Main diagonal:", reflect_diagonal(input_grid))
print("Anti-diagonal:", reflect_anti_diagonal(input_grid))
